tools.name: list_agent_sessions
tools.description: List your scoped autonomous agent sessions, newest first, with status, policy, remaining period cap, and expiry. Filter by status to find ACTIVE sessions ready to execute against.

tools.name: revoke_agent_session
tools.description: Revoke an agent session. This immediately halts all further execution on the backend (the execute path only runs ACTIVE sessions). The on-chain session remains installed until the user completes the uninstall in the Moneda app, but no payments can be made through it in the meantime. Use this when th

tools.name: list_active_sessions
tools.description: List the user's active login sessions (signed-in devices and clients: mobile app, web, CLI, API) and connected agents (MCP integrations). Use this to answer 'what devices am I signed in on?' or before terminating a session. Each login session has an `id` (pass to terminate_session), a `type`, device

tools.name: terminate_session
tools.description: Terminate one login session by id (from list_active_sessions). The device is signed out immediately and cannot renew. Returns { success } — false means the session was already gone or isn't the user's.

tools.name: terminate_all_other_sessions
tools.description: Terminate all of the user's login sessions on other devices (every signed-in app/web/CLI/API session). Does NOT disconnect agent connections — use disconnect_connected_service for those. Returns { revoked } = how many were terminated.

tools.name: disconnect_connected_service
tools.description: Disconnect a connected agent (MCP integration) by id (from list_active_sessions) or by its OAuth client id. Revokes its access immediately. If you disconnect the agent making this call, this connection ends.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List the API keys on the account: name, prefix (first 12 characters), scopes, last use, expiry, and whether each is still active. The secret itself is stored hashed and is never returned here — it is shown only once, when the key is created.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Create an API key for a script, the CLI, or an integration. Returns the secret ONCE — it cannot be retrieved again, so hand it to the user immediately and tell them to store it somewhere safe. Maximum 10 active keys. The key can only carry scopes this connection already holds, and payment scopes are

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke an API key by its id (from list_api_keys). The key stops working on its very next request. Irreversible — a new key must be created to restore access.

tools.name: purchase_usage_credits
tools.description: Redeem a CONFIRMED on-chain charge for prepaid AI usage credits. Provide the transactionHash of a completed transfer you (the user) sent to the Moneda treasury tagged as a usage-credit purchase. The amount is read from the verified on-chain charge — never from input — converted to USD budget with th

tools.name: set_ai_usage_limit
tools.description: Set (or clear) the monthly spend limit on AI usage credits — the ceiling on how much of the prepaid balance may be consumed per calendar month (resets the 1st, UTC). Pass a USD amount to cap spending, or null to remove the cap (unlimited). Idempotent: setting the same value twice is a no-op.

tools.name: get_points_redemption_config
tools.description: Read the config for redeeming Moneda Points into AI usage credits: the points-per-$1 rate, the minimum redemption, the monthly cap, the user's current points balance, and how much of the monthly allowance is left. Call this before redeem_points to price and gate a redemption.

tools.name: redeem_points
tools.description: Redeem the user's Moneda Points for prepaid AI usage credits. Spends points (a negative points transaction) and grants the matching AI budget atomically. Enforces the minimum, the sufficient-balance check, and the monthly cap (see get_points_redemption_config). Pass a stable requestId (uuid) held ac

tools.name: get_dinari_capabilities
tools.description: Check what the user may currently do with tokenized equities (dShares): whether they can trade, which regulatory jurisdiction they are onboarded under, and — if they cannot trade — the ordered list of reasons why. Call this before proposing any stock purchase so the user is told what to fix rather t

tools.name: get_dinari_us_requirements
tools.description: For a US-jurisdiction user, list what is still outstanding before their brokerage account can be opened: missing profile answers, unaccepted disclosures, and whether a taxpayer id is on file. Returns field NAMES and counts only, never the user's answers. Regulatory disclosures and attestations can o

tools.name: get_market_status
tools.description: Is the US stock market open, and when does it change? Returns the current session (pre_market, open, after_hours or closed), whether today is a trading day, any holiday or early close, the trading day's four windows as ISO instants, and the next session change. Render the instants in the user's own

tools.name: get_upcoming_ipos
tools.description: Companies that have filed with the SEC to go public in the US (S-1 or F-1) and have not listed yet: name, stage (filed, priced or listed), proposed ticker, website, and first and latest filing dates. Use for "what IPOs are coming up?" or "is X going public?". Nothing on the list can be bought until

tools.name: get_free_trade_allowance
tools.description: How many commission-free stock trades the user has left this window, without quoting an order. The window steps from their own subscription anniversary, not the calendar month, so quote resetsAt rather than a day of the month. If degraded is true the count could not be read: say so, never state it a

tools.name: list_conditional_orders
tools.description: List the user's crypto conditional orders (LIMIT / STOP_LOSS / TAKE_PROFIT / TRAILING_STOP, settled via CoW), newest first. Each has status (PENDING_ACTIVATION / ARMED / PUBLISHED / FILLED / CANCELLED / EXPIRED), side, assetSymbol, triggerPrice or trailPercent, raw-unit sellAmount / minBuyAmount, ex

tools.name: get_conditional_order
tools.description: Get one crypto conditional order by id, with its full status, trigger, amounts and fill details.

tools.name: cancel_conditional_order
tools.description: Cancel a crypto conditional order rule: every open repeat (PENDING_ACTIVATION, ARMED, PUBLISHED or WAITING) of the order's rule is cancelled, so passing any repeat's id stops the whole repeating rule. A PUBLISHED order is live in the CoW order book: it is withdrawn on-chain first, then marked CANCEL

tools.name: get_account_overview_data
tools.description: Fetch complete account overview in one call: balances, recent transactions (last 7 days), and current APY rates. Use this instead of calling get_balance + get_transactions + get_apy_rates separately.

tools.name: get_balance_check_data
tools.description: Fetch balance check data in one call: all account balances, exchange rates, and APY rates. Use this instead of calling get_balance + get_exchange_rate + get_apy_rates separately.

tools.name: get_financial_summary_data
tools.description: Fetch comprehensive financial summary data in one call: balances, recent transactions (10), APY rates, and exchange rates. Use this instead of calling 5+ individual tools.

tools.name: get_points_rewards_data
tools.description: Fetch points and referral data in one call: points balance, recent activity, referral code, and referees. Use this instead of calling get_points_balance + get_points_activity + get_referral_code + get_referees separately.

tools.name: get_earnings_overview_data
tools.description: Fetch earnings overview data in one call: earnings vault balances, APY rates, and recent earnings transactions. Use this instead of calling get_balance + get_apy_rates + get_transactions(typeGroup=earnings) separately.

tools.name: get_security_checkup_data
tools.description: Fetch security checkup data in one call: passkeys, recovery contacts, and security-related settings. Use this instead of calling get_passkeys + get_recovery_contacts + get_settings separately.

tools.name: get_my_accounts_data
tools.description: Fetch all account setup data in one call: wallet address, Moneda account balances, virtual bank accounts, and saved external accounts. Use this instead of calling get_wallet + get_balance + get_virtual_accounts + get_my_accounts separately.

tools.name: get_payment_readiness_data
tools.description: Fetch payment readiness data in one call: KYC status, virtual accounts, external accounts, contact count, and balances. Use this instead of calling 5 individual tools to check payment readiness.

tools.name: get_spending_analysis_data
tools.description: Fetch spending analysis data in one call: spending by type group, daily totals, and category breakdown for a period. Use this instead of calling get_spending_by_type_group + get_daily_spending + get_spending_by_category separately. All totals are in USDC units (26.5 means 26.50).

tools.name: generate_statement
tools.description: Generate a PDF balance statement of your activity (opening/closing balances, transactions with home-currency values, fees, FX rates) for a tax year or date range. Async: returns a requestId immediately — poll get_statement_status until it is READY to get a time-limited download link. Not tax advice.

tools.name: get_statement_status
tools.description: Check the status of your most recent balance-statement request. When READY, returns a time-limited PDF download URL. Not tax advice.
